facts.text: "Save me the scraps under the table. I'll take them on the Winnebago for later."
facts.why: Barf never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Barf, so it reads as a film line. His signature line is about being a Mawg.
facts.fix: I'm a Mawg, half man, half dog. I'm my own best friend.

fix_note.text: Save me the scraps under the table. I'll take them on the Winnebago for later.

facts.text: Skroob's combination / Same code as his luggage
facts.why: The air shield combination belongs to King Roland, and Dark Helmet gets it out of him by threatening Vespa. Skroob only says it is the same as the combination on his luggage.
facts.fix: King Roland's combination / Same code as Skroob's luggage

facts.why: Same mix up. It is King Roland's air shield code. The same line is printed in the footer crew notes.
The character is spelled Yogurt in the film and credits. The card also prints Yoghurt in the footer and the winks, and the parfait uses the food spelling, which is fine.
